CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of General Epistle: James? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Epistle: James.
   B. Use General Epistle: James to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of General Epistle: James with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say General Epistle: James has no place in daily life.

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

3. Which response best shows understanding of Monarchy in Israel: King David? (1 mark)
   A. Use Monarchy in Israel: King David to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Monarchy in Israel: King David.
   C. Say Monarchy in Israel: King David has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King David with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Biblical Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Biblical Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Biblical Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Biblical Stewardship has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Biblical Stewardship.

5. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings? (1 mark)
   A. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem.
   B. Say Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

8. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Hosea? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prophet Hosea has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Prophet Hosea with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Prophet Hosea to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Hosea.

9. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o? (1 mark)
   A. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection? (1 mark)
   A. Say Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection.
   C. Use Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Study Methods Devotional Method.
   C. Use Bible Study Methods Devotional Method to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Bible Study Methods Devotional Method has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain General Epistle: James and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain : 1Peter Selected teachings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Apply the teaching of General Epistle: James with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

3. D — Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King David with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Apply the teaching of Biblical Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

8. B — Apply the teaching of Prophet Hosea with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A — Apply the teaching of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. B — Apply the teaching of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
